cases.detail: IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.4.3 permits a string expression as the scan format. Icarus 13.0 compiles this case but vvp terminates with SIGSEGV. A reduced source using only a string format variable, without a method expression, also crashes. The string-source case with a literal format remains enabled.
